wholePhysicalScope: The UrbIS-sourced OpenStreetMap multipolygon fixes the attached exterior and three open courts. The museum entrance at number 10 and the mapped Autoworld part separate the signed museum frontage and its included volumes.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the main entrance, Antiquities Pavilion, several ranges and open courtyard plan.
limitations: Exterior footprint and courtyard openings follow the native map. Roof elevations, dome projection, columns, masonry colours and window groupings are approximate architectural interpretations.
The adjoining Autoworld hall and its roof, the central triumphal arch, upper monumental colonnade, collection interiors and landscaping are outside this scope.
The entrance stairs and terrain contact follow the mapped entrance and regional open elevation data. Individual steps and paving are simplified.
